verses.he: הֶן־כֹּ֖ל רָאֲתָ֣ה עֵינִ֑י שָֽׁמְעָ֥ה אָ֝זְנִ֗י וַתָּ֥בֶן לָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, Mine ear hath heard and  understood it.

verses.he: כְּֽ֭דַעְתְּכֶם יָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם־אָ֑נִי לֹא־נֹפֵ֖ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.en: What ye know, do I know also; I am not inferior unto you.

verses.he: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶל־שַׁדַּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְהוֹכֵ֖חַ אֶל־אֵ֣ל אֶחְפָּֽץ׃
verses.en: Notwithstanding I would speak to the Almighty, And I desire to reason with God.

verses.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם טֹֽפְלֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר רֹפְאֵ֖י אֱלִ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.en: But ye are plasterers of lies, Ye are all physicians of no value.

verses.he: מִֽי־יִ֭תֵּן הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישׁ֑וּן וּתְהִ֖י לָכֶ֣ם לְחָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: Oh that ye would altogether hold your peace! And it would be your wisdom.

verses.he: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֥א תוֹכַחְתִּ֑י וְרִב֖וֹת שְׂפָתַ֣י הַקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃
verses.en: Hear now my reasoning, And hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

verses.he: הַ֭לְאֵל תְּדַבְּר֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה וְ֝ל֗וֹ תְּֽדַבְּר֥וּ רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.en: Will ye speak unrighteously for God, And talk deceitfully for Him?

verses.he: הֲפָנָ֥יו תִּשָּׂא֑וּן אִם־לָאֵ֥ל תְּרִיבֽוּן׃
verses.en: Will ye show Him favour? Will ye contend for God?

verses.he: הֲ֭טוֹב כִּֽי־יַחְקֹ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־כְּהָתֵ֥ל בֶּ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ תְּהָתֵ֥לּוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Would it be good that He should search you out? Or as one mocketh a man, will ye mock Him?

verses.he: הוֹכֵ֣חַ יוֹכִ֣יחַ אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־בַּ֝סֵּ֗תֶר פָּנִ֥ים תִּשָּׂאֽוּן׃
verses.en: He will surely reprove you, If ye do secretly show favour.

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א שְׂ֭אֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵ֣ת אֶתְכֶ֑ם וּ֝פַחְדּ֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Shall not His majesty terrify you, And His dread fall upon you?

verses.he: זִֽ֭כְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי־אֵ֑פֶר לְגַבֵּי־חֹ֝֗מֶר גַּבֵּיכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Your memorials shall be like unto ashes, Your eminences to eminences of clay.

verses.he: הַחֲרִ֣ישׁוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה־אָ֑נִי וְיַעֲבֹ֖ר עָלַ֣י מָֽה׃
verses.en: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, And let come on me what will.

verses.he: עַל־מָ֤ה׀ אֶשָּׂ֣א בְשָׂרִ֣י בְשִׁנָּ֑י וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אָשִׂ֥ים בְּכַפִּֽי׃
verses.en: Wherefore? I will take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in my hand.

verses.he: הֵ֣ן יִ֭קְטְלֵנִי לא [ל֣וֹ] אֲיַחֵ֑ל אַךְ־דְּ֝רָכַ֗י אֶל־פָּנָ֥יו אוֹכִֽיחַ׃
verses.en: Though He slay me, yet will I trust in Him; But I will argue my ways before Him.

verses.he: גַּם־הוּא־לִ֥י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי־לֹ֥א לְ֝פָנָ֗יו חָנֵ֥ף יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.en: This also shall be my salvation, That a hypocrite cannot come before Him.

verses.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝אַֽחֲוָתִ֗י בְּאָזְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Hear diligently my speech, And let my declaration be in your ears.

verses.he: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א עָרַ֣כְתִּי מִשְׁפָּ֑ט יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י אֶצְדָּֽק׃
verses.en: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

verses.he: מִי־ה֭וּא יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י כִּֽי־עַתָּ֖ה אַחֲרִ֣ישׁ וְאֶגְוָֽע׃
verses.en: Who is he that will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and die.

verses.he: אַךְ־שְׁ֭תַּיִם אַל־תַּ֣עַשׂ עִמָּדִ֑י אָ֥ז מִ֝פָּנֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א אֶסָּתֵֽר׃
verses.en: Only do not two things unto me, Then will I not hide myself from Thee:

verses.he: כַּ֭פְּךָ מֵעָלַ֣י הַרְחַ֑ק וְ֝אֵ֥מָתְךָ֗ אַֽל־תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Withdraw Thy hand far from me; And let not Thy terror make me afraid.

verses.he: וּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה אֽוֹ־אֲ֝דַבֵּ֗ר וַהֲשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Then call Thou, and I will answer; Or let me speak, and answer Thou me.

verses.he: כַּמָּ֣ה לִ֭י עֲו‍ֹנ֣וֹת וְחַטָּא֑וֹת פִּֽשְׁעִ֥י וְ֝חַטָּאתִ֗י הֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.

verses.he: לָֽמָּה־פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר וְתַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: Wherefore hidest Thou Thy face, And holdest me for Thine enemy?

verses.he: הֶעָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֣ף תַּעֲר֑וֹץ וְאֶת־קַ֖שׁ יָבֵ֣שׁ תִּרְדֹּֽף׃
verses.en: Wilt Thou harass a driven leaf? And wilt Thou pursue the dry stubble?

verses.he: כִּֽי־תִכְתֹּ֣ב עָלַ֣י מְרֹר֑וֹת וְ֝תוֹרִישֵׁ֗נִי עֲו‍ֹנ֥וֹת נְעוּרָֽי׃
verses.en: That Thou shouldest write bitter things against me, And make me to inherit the iniquities of my youth.

verses.he: וְתָ֘שֵׂ֤ם בַּסַּ֨ד׀ רַגְלַ֗י וְתִשְׁמ֥וֹר כָּל־אָרְחוֹתָ֑י עַל־שָׁרְשֵׁ֥י רַ֝גְלַ֗י תִּתְחַקֶּֽה׃
verses.en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, And lookest narrowly unto all my paths; Thou drawest Thee a line about the soles of my feet;

verses.he: וְ֭הוּא כְּרָקָ֣ב יִבְלֶ֑ה כְּ֝בֶ֗גֶד אֲכָ֣לוֹ עָֽשׁ׃
verses.en: Though I am like a wine-skin that consumeth, Like a garment that is moth-eaten.
